evidence_quotation: 조선 태생의 한 마리 늘근 쥐(鼠)올시다 … 우리 조선도 세계 풍조에는 엇절 수 업든지
classification_rationale: Chosŏn as the homeland the narrator was born in and has returned to, invoked as a whole country in its present condition; no second country is set against it and no norm is applied to gisaeng.

evidence_quotation: 우리 조선에서는 아직 여기에 대하야 사회적 시설도 업고
classification_rationale: Korea's lack of dental provision is stated as a deficit measured against other countries; the article proceeds to a multi-country statistics table.
ontology_note: class set from the page text

evidence_quotation: 무궁화동산 우리 천지에도 산듯산듯한 바람이 불기 시작하야
classification_rationale: Homeland-as-whole frame: the space in which a new wind begins to blow. NOTE: the surface form is the epithet 무궁화동산, not a 조선-family token — the P30 assignment rests on referent, not wording.
ontology_note: surface form is an epithet; flagged

evidence_quotation: 이점에 잇서서 조선에 기생은 하로맛비 업새야 하켓으며
classification_rationale: Chosŏn is the national frame within which the institution of the gisaeng is to be abolished; a reform claim scoped to the country, not a located action.
ontology_note: class set from the page text

evidence_quotation: 머리털로써 女姓美의 한 큰 조건을 삼는 朝蘇婦人으로서는
classification_rationale: Immediately preceded by 歐米 women's hat-wearing; Korean women are set against European and American practice. RECLASSIFIED from 'normative' as reported in STAGE3_CONTROLS_REPORT §3 — the surrounding 歐米 contrast is explicit on the page.
ontology_note: DIFFERS FROM EARLIER REPORT — see note

evidence_quotation: 朝蘇의 固有한 朝蘇的 情總가 있어야 할 터인데 모든 것이 日本 것을 흉내내인 것이 잇서
classification_rationale: A foreign observer prescribes that gisaeng ought to be authentically Korean rather than imitative of Japan; Korea functions as a standard of authenticity.
ontology_note: class set from the page text

evidence_quotation: 內地의 게이샤를 보고 놀내인 나는 朝蘇에 와서 또 한 번 놀나지안이치 못하엿슴니다
classification_rationale: Korea is the actual location the writer travelled to and is speaking from; a located presence, not a frame or a norm.
ontology_note: class set from the page text

evidence_quotation: 가장 홀늄한 朝蘇의 技生이 되시요
classification_rationale: Closing exhortation: become the finest Korean gisaeng. Korea supplies the standard the addressee is told to meet.
ontology_note: class set from the page text

evidence_quotation: 나는 朝蘇에 나온 지가 거진 三十年이나 되는 사람임니다 … 朝蘇은 나의 第二 故劉
classification_rationale: Korea as the writer's place of actual residence for some thirty years and his declared second homeland.
ontology_note: class set from the page text

evidence_quotation: 朝蘇의 固有한 藝術을 몸의 익히여서 참다운 妹生 … 이 되시요
classification_rationale: Prescribes mastery of Korea's own art as the condition of being a true gisaeng; an authenticity standard.
ontology_note: class set from the page text

evidence_quotation: 저는 본래 남조선의 한 모통이에서 태여난 뭄으로
classification_rationale: A stated birthplace — a corner of southern Chosŏn; a located origin, though sub-national precision is not recoverable.
ontology_note: class set from the page text

evidence_quotation: 朝蘇에도 近者에는 어지간히 珍奇한 我判이 일어낫다 … 그러치만 아직 外國과 갓치 뛰어난 것은 별로히 볼 수가 업다
classification_rationale: Korea's divorce cases are explicitly measured against 外國; the article then recounts American cases.
